impact: v2 save silently fails with "no committed segments available to pin" (T-038 classification: rolling-buffer seal failure). T-039 commit-path classification: B4 — segments_committed > 0 (confirmed up to 8 across 4 attempts) but replay pin always empty. durElig=false persists regardless of committed count. Hypothesis: helper pin predicate requires duration_eligible=true for in-progress segment; encode rate under static-screen content (~5% real-time) means pending segment never reaches PTS duration threshold. Evidence: .story/handovers/evidence/2026-05-24-iss-015-commit-path-classification/. Related: T-038 (reason classification), T-039 (commit-path classification).
title: v2 save silently fails: SAVING→RECORDING with no snapshot ID despite valid rolling buffer segments
